title: Marvell-Lumentum deal tests whether AI optics go single-vendor
content: Who gets the lasers? Marvell's Lumentum deal puts a big InP fab inside an AI chip company just as telecom and datacom buyers compete for the same supply.

title: Telstra thinks Australia could become AI’s trusted Asia-Pacific hub
content: Countries across Asia-Pacific are racing to build data centers, but Telstra is betting on Australia. The big question is whether subsea cables and fiber can keep pace with demand.

title: AMD: Earnings Call: Q3 2026
content: Q3 set records for revenue and operating income, led by Data Center, while Client and Gaming weakened. Management expects >80% revenue growth in 2027, with supply constraints and a declining PC market among key risks.
